title: docs/INTEGRATION.md: how kernel consumers use crypto2dev
description: User-facing documentation explaining how to integrate wolfkm into a Linux system. Sections: (1) Prerequisites (wolfcrypt.ko, kernel version, module signing); (2) Installation (insmod order, modprobe.d config); (3) Verification (scripts/verify_registration.sh, /proc/crypto); (4) dm-crypt/LUKS (cryptsetup cipher string, crypttab example); (5) IPsec/xfrm (strongSwan/iproute2 config snippet); (6) /dev/wolfcrypt userspace API (wolfkm_status, wolfkm_benchmark); (7) Disabling built-in crypto (when/why, scripts/disable_builtin_crypto.sh); (8) Troubleshooting (common dmesg errors and fixes).
design: Target audience: Linux sysadmins and security engineers deploying FIPS-validated crypto. Assume kernel knowledge but not wolfSSL knowledge. Include concrete commands, expected dmesg output, and /proc/crypto snippets. Cross-reference human_tasks/ for items requiring CMVP/legal action.
